options.label: Automatically store scrolls
options.tooltip: Moves eligible acquired scrolls to Spatial Storage.

options.label: Automatically store potions
options.tooltip: Moves eligible acquired potions to Spatial Storage.

options.label: Automatically store books
options.tooltip: Moves eligible acquired books, notes, and journals to Spatial Storage.

options.label: Item scale (%)
options.tooltip: Sets the size of spell entries in Spatial Storage. Allowed range: 25-100%. The default is 75%.

options.label: Keep storage open for untargeted actions
options.tooltip: Keeps Spatial Storage open after drinking a potion or casting a personal-range scroll.

options.label: Debug messages
options.tooltip: Writes detailed Scriptorium transfer tracing to the character chat and nwengineLog.txt.
